body.name: Exact simultaneous multinomial confidence fiber
body.construction: \(C_{n,\alpha}=\{p'\in\Delta(\mathcal O):2nD_{\mathrm{KL}}(\widehat p_n\Vert p')\le c_{n,\alpha}(p')\}\), where \(c_{n,\alpha}(p')\) is the smallest \((1-\alpha)\)-quantile under \(n\widehat p_n\sim\mathrm{Multinomial}(n,p')\) and the conventions are \(0\log(0/x)=0\) and \(x\log(x/0)=+\infty\) for \(x>0\).
